rows.note: Checked on 2026-09-30 (sandbox only, no model calls) and again by the 2026-10-03 live run. Forwarding serializer_kwargs to loads makes the repository's own test_serializer_kwargs fail: it passes skipkeys, which json.dumps accepts and json.loads does not. serializer_kwargs is probably meant for dumps only, so this issue is likely intended behaviour, not a bug. The 2026-10-03 patch passes the agent's own test because that test checks only that the keyword arguments reach loads.

@@ -2496,6 +2496,9 @@ def _expand_iterable(original, num_desired, default):
 def _pad_row(cells, padding):
     if cells:
         if cells == SEPARATING_LINE:
+            # When we encounter a SEPARATING_LINE, we need to create a full-width separator

             return SEPARATING_LINE
         pad = " " * padding
         padded_cells = [pad + cell + pad for cell in cells]
